prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in League City, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1476; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, but you can use the claim reference.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was stopped at a red light on a main road in League City, in the right lane, waiting to turn.

Q: What happened next?

A: I felt a hard jolt from behind. The other car hit me going pretty fast, I'd say faster than the traffic around us. My head snapped back and then forward.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: Not really. I saw it in my mirror a second before, but I didn't have time to react.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, and the airbag didn't deploy. My car was pushed into the vehicle in front of me.

Q: Did you go to a doctor or emergency room?

A: I went to urgent care that same afternoon. They said I had a back strain and gave me muscle relaxers and told me to rest.

Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms?

A: Yes. My lower back is stiff, especially in the morning, and sitting for long periods is uncomfortable. I've missed a few days of work because of it.

Q: Have you had any prior injuries to your back?

A: No, nothing serious. I had some soreness years ago after lifting something, but nothing that needed treatment.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: I just want to make sure my medical bills and lost time get covered. I've been doing my best to follow the doctor's instructions.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
